title: Sharp Conditioning for Matrix Recovery by Finite Affine Orbits
summary: Let \(q=p^h\) be an odd prime power, and let the affine group \(\mathbb F_q\rtimes\mathbb F_q^\times\) act through its canonical \((q-1)\)-dimensional irreducible representation. Qualitative matrix recovery for these rank-one orbits is known. We determine sharp lower singular-value bounds for explicit real generating windows. First, we compute the exact least singular value for every nonnegative two-level window over \(\mathbb F_{p^h}\) with \(h\geq2\), and identify the unique optimizer when \(q-1\geq10\).
